drafted_from: tool:read-what-is-waiting-on-me's own row, read-data/waiting-sources.json and test/waiting-records.test.mjs
start_here: Say to your AI: "Read what is waiting on me from every source I keep." It reads the person's own stores for the records each source names, runs each reader tool a source names, hands both to tool:read-what-is-waiting-on-me, and answers the cards in sections, with each source that could not be read named.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of yours: it reads your record:waiting-sources rows over the shipped source DATA and gathers cards without writing. The records it needs are read by your AI from your own stores and handed in.
instructions: 1. Optionally add record:waiting-sources rows to extend or override read-data/waiting-sources.json. Read them and every record kind the sources read (record:waiting-on-you, post, calendar-task and the rest) from the person's own store, as stored: [{ id, type, value }].

2. Run each reader tool a source names (tool:my-notification-devices, tool:see-my-decisions) with its declared input, follow its cursor until none is left, and keep each result in order as pages: { [tool id]: [result, ...] }.
3. The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:read-what-is-waiting-on-me and { stored, pages }.
4. Read cards, sections, count and said; a source with unread true was not read, so the answer is incomplete for it.
5. Finish one card with tool:finish-what-is-waiting-on-me when its source declares a same-record completion.

worked_examples.title: An unread source is said, never hidden

input.stored: the records read in steps 1 and 2

worked_examples.given: From test/waiting-records.test.mjs: one ask record, one post to approve and a source named given that could not be read.
worked_examples.hands_back: It answered sections with the post card at address "/use/check-a-post/post:sample", source "given" with unread true, and said naming that source as not read.
